contract.title: A11H — held-out/rollout receipt schemas and parsers (packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-heldout-receipts.ts)
contract.invariant: A11H held-out/rollout receipts enforce exact fields AND the I0→I1→I2→I3→(I4|I3R) chain by exact previousReceiptSha256 equality — a foreign predecessor digest must be rejected, not merely accepted as a syntactically valid hash; acceptance and rejection are mutually exclusive for one opening record.
production_callers: packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-policy-qualification-writer.ts (F9, future — consumes A6/A11Q/A11H held-out acceptance/rejection receipts for activation/revocation transitions; not present at base)
scripts/ranking-v3-heldout-activation.test.mjs (G6C, future — activation cycle binds H10 pending-registry digest and exactly one I4/I3R terminal chain)
H10/H1–H9 execution cards (future — pre-held-out and qualification-cycle receipts bind A11H/A11Q predecessor authorities)
test_callers: packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-heldout-receipts.test.ts (future; none existing at base — RED row test name: heldout_chain_rejects_foreign_previous_receipt_digest)
interface_changes: packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-heldout-receipts.ts: OwnerAuthorizationReceiptV1, HeldoutOpeningRecordV1, HeldoutExecutionReceiptV1, HeldoutAcceptanceReceiptV1, HeldoutRejectionReceiptV1, RolloutSelectionReceiptV1, RollbackDrillReceiptV1, LimitedActivationReceiptV1
security_boundaries: Exact predecessor equality: I0→I1→I2→I3→(I4|I3R) chain enforced by previousReceiptSha256; for I4 and I3R it must equal the accepted or rejected I3 receipt digest — a chain with a foreign predecessor must fail to parse (plan §7.6 RED row)

Acceptance and rejection are mutually exclusive for one opening record (HeldoutAcceptanceReceiptV1 decision 'accepted' vs HeldoutRejectionReceiptV1 decision 'rejected' on the same executionReceiptSha256)
I4/I3R terminal chain binds the H10 pending-registry digest (per G6C activation-cycle row)
Unknown keys are rejected for every held-out/rollout/rollback/activation authority (§5.6 closing rule)
overlap_with: FT-A1 (A11H requires A6 and A11Q; prerequisite row A11H: R1.6, A6, A11Q, R1.3, R1.4)
FT-F (F9 consumes A11H held-out acceptance/rejection receipts)
FT-G (G6C binds A11H I4/I3R terminal chain)
contract.instructions: Implement the A11H receipt schemas in packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-heldout-receipts.ts exactly per plan §5.5 (owner-authorization, held-out opening record, held-out execution, held-out acceptance, held-out rejection, rollout selection, rollback drill, limited activation). Parsers must reject unknown keys and produce stable canonical round trips. First-RED test (plan §7.6): packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-heldout-receipts.test.ts — 'heldout_chain_rejects_foreign_previous_receipt_digest'; expected failure before implementation is that an I2/I3/I4 chain with a foreign predecessor parses; minimal passing behavior is that exact predecessor digest equality is required. Tests must verify exact digest equality and acceptance/rejection exclusivity for one opening record, not merely syntactic hash validity. Do not widen scope into A11Q-owned qualification/registry envelopes or A6-owned registry types. Do not modify the parent integration checkout. NOTE: the focused command is plan-specified (§7.5) and targets a future test file that does not exist at round_base — unverifiable-at-base; the affected command is repo-verified (packages/mcp/package.json test script exists) but cannot exercise A11H code until the file exists.
